bounded_contexts.name: cloud-iac
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud IaC local foundation for metadata-only OpenTofu module release records, in-memory module registry invariants, cell topology planning metadata, GitOps reconciliation evidence, and the existing IaC tier-discipline gate. No live OpenTofu registry API, REST/SDK/worker runtime, provider plan/apply, Argo CD API integration, measured SLO, active-active DR, sharding automation, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by CS-CLOUD-IAC-001. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-API-BOUNDARY-001 adds a pure Rust API boundary for OpenTofu module registry discovery, versions, and download DTOs only; no REST server or live endpoint is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-ROUTE-BOUNDARY-001 adds a pure in-process route boundary for the OpenTofu module registry discovery, versions, and download paths only; no HTTP server or live endpoint is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-REST-ROUTER-001 adds a framework-free REST router boundary registered with oya-http-router-kernel for OpenTofu module registry discovery, versions, and download routes only; no live HTTP listener/server/runtime is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-RUNTIME-COMPOSITION-001 adds an in-process runtime composition crate that dispatches REST-router matches into the API DTO boundary only; no live HTTP listener/server, deployed endpoint, auth runtime, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-HTTP-HANDLER-001 adds a transport-neutral HTTP handler boundary that renders OpenTofu-compatible JSON responses from the runtime dispatcher only; no live HTTP listener/server, deployed endpoint, auth runtime, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-SERVICE-ASSEMBLY-001 assembles the transport-neutral handler into the canonical Hyper-adapter router/middleware dispatch path only; no socket bind, live listener/server, deployed endpoint, auth runtime, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-METHOD-SEAM-001 corrects the canonical router/Hyper-adapter dispatch seam so registered OpenTofu module-registry paths with unsupported methods return 405 while unknown paths remain 404; no socket bind, live listener/server, deployed endpoint, auth runtime, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-LOOPBACK-LISTENER-001 adds deterministic one-connection local loopback listener evidence for the assembled module-registry service through Hyper request/response conversion only; no daemonized listener, deployed endpoint, auth runtime, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-APP-ENTRYPOINT-001 adds a local app composition root with health/liveness routes, binary entrypoint metadata, Helm cargoPackage alignment, and a bounded loopback daemon harness only; no deployed endpoint, production auth runtime, persistence, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, Argo CD rollout, Kubernetes rollout, measured SLO, DR, or cloud provisioning is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-APP-RELEASE-INDEX-LOAD-001 adds a constrained std-only loader that reads the gate-validated repo-local OpenTofu module release-index into the local app registry at startup; no registry publish path, object-store archive serving, production auth runtime, deployed endpoint, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning is claimed. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-APP-ARTIFACT-DOWNLOAD-001 aligns the local app download response with repo-local protocol fixtures by returning /artifacts/modules/<archive>.zip locations and serving matching local archive bytes from the deterministic archive root when present; this is local filesystem artifact serving only, with no object store, production auth runtime, deployed endpoint, registry publish path, signed modules, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning claim. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-APP-ARCHIVE-DIGEST-001 adds request-time SHA-256 verification before the local app serves module archive bytes from the deterministic archive root; this is local filesystem integrity checking only, with no signing/SLSA/VSA attestation verification, object store, production auth runtime, deployed endpoint, registry publish path, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning claim. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-APP-REQUEST-AUTH-001 adds a local fail-closed bearer-header gate for registered OpenTofu module-registry and artifact routes while keeping /healthz and /livez public; this is a local request-auth seam only, with no production auth/Cedar runtime, tenant identity, token issuance/rotation, TLS termination, deployed endpoint, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning claim. CS-CLOUD-IAC-MODULE-REGISTRY-APP-OBJECT-SOURCE-001 adds optional OpenTofu s3::https:// and gcs::https:// archive source locations for module-registry download responses; this is a source-location contract only, with no live object-store upload/download serving, bucket provisioning, IAM policy, object versioning/generation enforcement, signed URL, CDN, deployed endpoint, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning claim.

slo_exemption.rationale: No current measured runtime SLI exists for this foundation, retired, or local-scaffold service; the manifest must not claim production or hyperscaler-ready SLO coverage until an OpenSLO file lands.
